title: Post-exit scaling, one-third liar agents, N=12

notes: Claude Haiku 4.5 on the ego-depletion claim.
4 liar agents each speak once and exit; 8 neutral agents then receive two turns each.
Matched conditions differ only in whether memory entries written by departed liar agents are retained or removed.
Seeds 0 through 11 rotate speaking order within each role group.
